options.content:
## IREN_MKZ fabric topology — three planes

[**NVIS Home**](/d/nvis-home) · [IB Fabric Home](/d/nvis-l2-ib-fabric) · [Switches — Quantum-3 Fleet](/d/nvis-ib-switches) · [NVSwitch Fleet](/d/nvis-nvswitch-fleet) · [Ethernet Fabric](/d/nvis-eth-fabric-overview)

Switches grouped by role (leaf / spine / core) and by the compute they connect. Use the data-hall, SU and rack pickers at the top to scope the board.

**Producer status.** This board is built on the fabric-manager collectors — UFM (`ufm_*`), the IB identity and cable-audit sweeps (`ib_switch_*`, `ib_cable_*`), the LLDP collector (`ibl_*`), NVLMapper (`nvlmapper_*`) and Cumulus (`cumulus_*`). Those exporters are stopped, so the panels below read no value; they are left in place and repopulate when the exporters return. The live equivalents today are the Quantum-3 switch fleet, the NVSwitch fleet and the host-side Ethernet counters, linked above.

panels.description: ufm_fabric_healthy as published by the UFM controller: 1 = the subnet manager reports a converged, alarm-free fabric.
panels.title: UFM fabric-healthy flag

panels.description: ufm_port_count_by_phys_state{phys_state="Link Up"} summed over the ports UFM manages. This is UFM’s own slice, not a fabric-wide port count.
panels.title: IB ports in Link Up (UFM slice)

panels.description: ufm_port_count minus ufm_port_active_count over the ports UFM manages.
panels.title: IB ports not active (UFM slice)

panels.description: ib_cable_active_issues_total — open cabling and topology findings at the last audit sweep. Cross-check the audited-switch count in section ③ before reading a 0 as clean.
panels.title: Open IB cable / topology issues

panels.description: count(ib_switch_scrape_success == 1) — switches the identity/audit collector polled successfully on its last pass.
panels.title: IB switches answering the identity scrape

panels.description: Seconds since nvlmapper_last_scan_timestamp_seconds. NVLMapper publishes health scalars only; per-port NVLink telemetry is on the NVLink boards.
panels.title: NVLMapper scan age

panels.description: Distinct device labels on cumulus_interface_oper_state — Cumulus switches reporting interface state.
panels.title: Ethernet switches reporting (Cumulus)

panels.description: One row per switch from the identity and LLDP sweeps: audit scrape result, management-SSH reachability, active ports and optic modules. Active-port and optic counts only exist for switches that answered.

defaults.noValue: no samples in the selected window

panels.title: IB switches — role · scrape · SSH · active ports · optics

panels.description: ib_switch_by_role — the identity sweep’s split of the IB switch inventory into core/spine and ToR/leaf.

defaults.noValue: no samples in the selected window

panels.title: IB switches by role

panels.description: ib_switch_active_ports — emitted only for the switches the live exporter could read. This family carries no role label.

defaults.noValue: no samples in the selected window

panels.title: IB active ports per switch
② InfiniBand — Leaf / Spine Switch Inventory (grouped by role)

panels.description: ib_switch_active_ports and ib_switch_optic_modules per switch — the blast-radius denominator for each leaf/spine.

defaults.noValue: no samples in the selected window

panels.title: Per-switch active ports & optic modules

panels.description: Fleet-wide counts rather than one line per switch: how many switches were SSH-reachable and how many completed an audit scrape on each pass. Per-switch detail is in the table above.

defaults.noValue: no samples in the selected window

panels.title: IB reachability & audit success over time

panels.description: The full cable-audit result set. Read “Switches audited” first — if it is 0 then “Open issues = 0” means the sweep audited nothing (SSH reachability gates it), not that the cabling is clean.

defaults.noValue: no samples in the selected window

panels.title: IB cable / topology audit — last sweep
③ Switch → Connected Nodes (blast radius for the scope)

panels.description: nvlmapper_exporter_up — the NVLMapper collector’s own health flag.
panels.title: NVLMapper exporter

panels.description: rate() of cumulus_nvswitch_interface_if_in_errors / if_out_errors and if_in_discards / if_out_discards, summed per device, top 15.

defaults.noValue: no samples in the selected window

panels.title: Ethernet interface errors & discards per device — top 15
